Abstract gives no training programme. Full text not retrievable (Europe PMC XML and PDF refused, PMC page blocked), so RT cannot be settled here; decide at full text, E03 if no structured RT

Jones 1999: double-blind RCT, CrM loading + 5 g/d vs placebo for 10 wk in 16 elite ice-hockey players; abstract reports cycle and skating sprints only. RT programme and any strength/body-mass/AE data not stated; not in Europe PMC. Kept maybe under the 'athletes for weeks, RT not stated' convention (cf. SP1-0255, SP7-0041); E03 or E05 at full text if neither is present

E03: Pluim 2006, full text read (PMC2465117): creatine vs placebo in tennis players doing tennis training only. No RT programme in the analysed sample. Body mass +1.4 vs -0.2 kg and no renal/liver changes are safety context only

E03: Pereira 2015: single-blind non-counterbalanced crossover, acute and 30-d creatine vs placebo in healthy adults; urinary heterocyclic amines; no RT programme, no eligible outcome. Not in Europe PMC

Zajac 2020, full text read (PMC7600931): randomised, magnesium creatine chelate 5.5 g/d vs starch placebo, 16 wk in-season, 20 elite soccer players (16 completed), age 25.6 +/- 3.7 y. Both arms did the same team training plus a strength and conditioning session twice a week. Eligible outcomes: body mass and FFM (BIA), serum creatinine. Include; at full-text eligibility judge whether the twice-weekly S&C counts as structured RT (content not described) and analyse as non-monohydrate form

SR/MA mapping: Kreider 2025, full text read (PMC11983583). Creatine-specific; PubMed search plus the PI's own database, 3,445 records, PRISMA flow, 685 human creatine trials of any population and training status, so trials meeting our PICOS are admitted; side-effect prevalence pooled at study level. Supplemental File 1 lists all 685 trials (useful for citation chasing). Weak as a review: one database, no dual screening stated, vote counting. F-COI: publication fee paid by AlzChem; lead author chairs AlzChem's scientific advisory board. Same review family as SP7-0145

SR/MA mapping: Gonzalez 2026, full text read (PMC13120166). Secondary dose- and duration-response analysis of the same search and dataset as SP7-0132 (it cites that paper for the 3,445-record search; 684 of the 685 trials). Creatine-specific and admits trials meeting our PICOS, so it passes the SR/MA rule, but link it to SP7-0132 and count the two as one review family for AMSTAR 2 and overlap. F-COI: authors report AlzChem and other creatine-industry ties

Greenwood 2003, full text read (PMC233174): open-label, self-selected creatine users (n=38) vs non-users (n=34), one Division IA football season. Full text states training 'consisted of resistance training and conditioning drills (1-2 h/d, 4 d/wk)', fall camp and in-season practice, all supervised. Cramping, heat illness, strains and injury counts are eligible adverse-event outcomes. Non-randomised, so safety outcomes only (ROBINS-I), as SP7-0022; check cohort overlap with SP7-0022 and PMID 12701814
